meta.title: Living in Madeira
meta.note: Modules of lessons, each a scene with a goal the coach can check. A free conversation is where you end up, not where a learner starts: the missing rung is knowing what you are trying to achieve and being told when you achieved it. Lessons reuse the coach personas from src/coach.js.

modules.title: First contacts
modules.blurb: The exchanges you have before you can have any others.

lessons.title: Order at a café
lessons.goal: Greet the barista, order a coffee and something to eat, then ask for the bill.
must: a greeting appropriate to the time of day
an order that includes se faz favor or por favor
phrases: Queria um café, se faz favor

lessons.title: Say who you are
lessons.goal: Tell the neighbour your name, where you are from and how long you have lived here.
must: where you are from, using ser
how long you have lived here, using morar and há

lessons.title: Ask them to slow down
lessons.goal: The seller speaks fast. Say you are still learning, ask them to repeat and to speak more slowly, and finish your purchase anyway.
must: saying you do not understand or are still learning
asking them to repeat or slow down

modules.title: Getting around
modules.blurb: Buses that come late, taxis, and asking the way without a map.

lessons.title: Take the bus
lessons.goal: Say where you are going, ask the price and whether the bus stops near the market.

lessons.title: Take a taxi to the airport
lessons.goal: Give the destination, ask how long it takes and whether you can pay by card.
phrases: Para o aeroporto, se faz favor

modules.title: Shops and money
modules.blurb: Prices, change, and the words that appear on a receipt.

lessons.title: Buy at the market
lessons.goal: Ask the price per kilo, buy half a kilo of something, and ask if they have change for twenty euros.

lessons.title: Sort out a card problem
lessons.goal: Explain that your card does not work, say since when, and ask what you need to bring.

modules.title: Home and neighbours
modules.blurb: The building, the landlord, and the noise upstairs.

lessons.title: Report a breakdown
lessons.goal: Report that the lift is broken and there is no hot water, and ask when it will be fixed.
must: asking when it will be repaired

lessons.title: View a flat
lessons.goal: Ask the rent, whether bills are included, and when you could move in.

lessons.title: The noise last night
lessons.goal: Apologise, explain what happened, and promise it will not happen again — politely enough to keep the neighbour.

modules.title: When something hurts
modules.blurb: The pharmacy first, the doctor second, and the words for both.

lessons.title: At the pharmacy
lessons.goal: Describe a symptom, ask whether you need a prescription, and ask how to take the medicine.

lessons.title: Book and describe
lessons.goal: Say what hurts, since when, and answer whether you have a fever.

modules.title: Paperwork
modules.blurb: The counter, the queue ticket, and the appointment you booked in March.

lessons.title: At AIMA
lessons.goal: Say you have an appointment and at what time, hand over your documents, and ask what happens next.

lessons.title: Call support
lessons.goal: Explain that the internet has been down since yesterday, give your client number, and ask for a technician.
phrases: A internet não funciona desde ontem
O meu número de cliente é…
